articles.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people
articles.description: Children are among the victims, authorities say, and more victims could still be buried in the rubble of a large apartment block that was destroyed.

articles.title: Flydubai attacker began a 'drift towards extremism and terrorism' in Australia, UAE says
articles.description: The United Arab Emirates' attorney-general also alleges the co-pilot was trying to crash the plane into Tel Aviv's airport.

articles.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'
articles.description: Several member states of the international tribunal, including the UK, say they "strongly disagree" with the sanctions.

articles.title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
articles.description: Often dubbed "Russia's Google", the tech firm admits customers may experience disruption to digital services due to the attacks.

articles.title: Flydubai hijacker planned to crash aircraft in 9/11-inspired attack, UAE says
articles.description: The alleged hijacker of a flydubai plane planned to crash into Israel's Ben Gurion airport, according to a senior Emirati official.

articles.title: Three killed in Houthi-claimed strikes on Saudi Arabian airport
articles.description: Three Saudi citizens, including an airline pilot, were killed in attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, the country's civil aviation authority said.
